stories.headline: Nigeria finds no Ebola spread after 21-day monitoring
body: Nigeria completed 21-day monitoring of 62 contacts of its first Ebola case in over a decade.
None of them caught the disease.
stories.vc: Containing outbreaks early saves billions in health and trade costs.

stories.headline: Paraguay's ousted president faces a new charge over bank collapse
body: Prosecutors charged Santiago Peña with criminal association over the Ueno bank collapse.
He already faces breach of trust and self-dealing charges.
He is held at a military facility.
stories.vc: The case could reshape how Paraguay oversees digital banks.

stories.headline: Paytm moves closer to reviving its wallet business
body: Paytm's payments arm got in-principle RBI approval to run digital wallets.
Its wallet business was hit by RBI curbs in 2024.
It must finish a security audit within six months.
stories.joke: The wallet is coming back, minus the drama, hopefully.
stories.vc: A wallet return could restore a revenue stream for Paytm.

stories.headline: SoftBank sells ₹1,885 crore of Meesho shares
body: SoftBank sold 7.6 crore Meesho shares in a block deal.
It's booking profits after a sharp rise in Meesho's share price.
Buyers included Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs and Indian mutual funds.
stories.joke: SoftBank cashing in: a rare sight.
stories.vc: Strong demand for the block shows confidence in Meesho.

stories.headline: Startup Drogue wants ocean heat to power floating data centres
body: Startup Drogue is building a system to use ocean heat to power data centres on ships.
Its first prototype should be at sea in under two years.
stories.joke: Cloud computing, but literally at sea.
stories.vc: New power sources for AI are drawing early-stage climate investors.
